title: Invariant 1: PostgreSQL/RuVector contains host ALL data and remains the Swarm Primary Runtime.
goal: Prove operational invariant 1 holds against the live system. Shipped evidence only: a design document, a proposed ADR, or an intent to build never satisfies this probe.
verification_command: bash -lc 'PSQL="$(command -v psql || echo "$(dirname "$(readlink -f /proc/$(head -1 /home/flexnetos/meta/var/lib/postgresql/17/postmaster.pid 2>/dev/null)/exe 2>/dev/null)")/psql")"; test -x "$PSQL" && "$PSQL" '"'"'postgresql:///lifeos?host=/home/flexnetos/meta/var/run/postgresql'"'"' -tAc '"'"'select 1 from pg_extension where extname=$$ruvector$$'"'"' | grep -q 1'
completion_gate: probe exits 0 against the live system; a non-zero exit is a real invariant violation and must not be recorded as pending or proposed
rollback_plan: Read-only probe; nothing to roll back.
